title: SEC0: T4-T8 test helper copy not production code
description: config.rs:790-811 defines whitelist_check() which duplicates normalization+containment logic from session.rs:171-194. T4-T8 (especially T7 IPv4-mapped regression test) call this copy, not run_session(). If production normalization in session.rs changes, T7 passes while the real code regresses silently. Fix: extract normalization into a pub(crate) fn in session.rs and test that directly, or drive an SMTP session with an IPv4-mapped peer_addr.
notes: SEC7 calibration: confirmed P1. T7 is the regression test specifically for the IPv4-mapped normalization bug. It calls whitelist_check() in config.rs, not the production normalization in session.rs:179-185. If a maintainer changes session.rs:181 from to_ipv4_mapped() back to to_ipv4(), T7 passes while production regresses. This is a concrete test integrity violation per CLAUDE.md: 'Tests must have an independent oracle' — the copy is not independent. Distinguished from 1onm.16 (P2): 1onm.16 is the maintainer-burden framing; 1onm.11 is the test integrity framing. Both describe the same root cause but 1onm.11 has the stronger safety implication. 1onm.16 can be treated as a duplicate. The fix (extract pub(crate) fn, described in 1onm.2 and 1onm.9) resolves all four issues.
